exposure: intragenic duplication in the AFF2 gene
direct tandem intragenic duplication of exons 10, 11 and 12
outcome: significant reduction in AFF2 gene expression levels
cohort: The study describes a patient, his mother, and his maternal aunt (dizygotic twins) who are affected family members presenting with an intragenic duplication in the AFF2 gene.
finding: An X-linked intragenic duplication in the AFF2 gene (duplication of exons 10, 11, and 12) was found in affected family members, leading to an aberrant transcript and reduced gene expression, which consistently gave rise to a classic Cornelia de Lange syndrome (CdLS) phenotype, suggesting AFF2 as a causative gene for this syndrome.
